$comment: Generated from CapturePageFile in src/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. What the browser saw on one c.capture(): an attempt's artifacts/<name>.capture.json.
title: CapturePageFile

CaptureConsoleMessage.description: One message the page's console showed while it was captured.

source.description: `console-api` for the page's `console.*` calls; otherwise the browser's own source, such as `network` (a request that failed), `javascript`, `security` or `deprecation`.

text.description: The message, at most 2000 characters, with the app's own URLs as paths.

url.description: The script or resource it came from, as a path when it's on the app.

CaptureFailedRequest.description: A request the page made that failed or answered 400 or above.

error.description: The browser's error, such as `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; absent when a response came.

status.description: The response's status; absent when no response came.

url.description: As a path when it's on the app.

CapturePageFile.description: A capture's `artifacts/<name>.capture.json`: its page facts, versioned.

console.description: Each message the console showed, in order; at most 100 of each level.

dropped.description: How many messages, errors and requests the caps left out; absent when none.

errors.description: The page errors: each uncaught exception and unhandled promise rejection, with its stack, at most 100.

failedRequests.description: Requests that failed or answered 400 or above, in order, at most 100.

finalUrl.description: Where the page ended up, after redirects and client-side routing: a path on the app.

status.description: The HTTP status of the main frame's latest document, after redirects. A full navigation replaces it; a client-side route change keeps it. Absent when no response came.
